card.line: Ophir was a faraway region famous for its fine gold, and ships sailed there for Solomon, whose gold helped beautify the Lord's temple and palace.

moments.title: Solomon's gold fleet
moments.text: Hiram sent skilled sailors to serve with Solomon's servants. They sailed to Ophir and brought gold back to Solomon.

moments.title: Almug wood and gems
moments.text: Hiram's fleet also brought a great cargo of almug wood and precious stones from Ophir. Solomon made the wood into steps for the LORD's house and the palace, and into lyres and harps.

moments.title: David gives Ophir gold
moments.text: David gave 3,000 talents of the gold of Ophir for the temple, to overlay the walls. Then the leaders gave willingly too.

moments.title: Jehoshaphat's ships wrecked
moments.text: Jehoshaphat built ships to go to Ophir for gold. They never set sail, because they were wrecked at Ezion-geber.
